subject: Psychology

internalBreakdown.component: Viva voce (case profile and two tests)

notes: The document has no learning-outcomes column for Psychology, so chapter outcomes are left empty.
Practical: develop a case profile and administer and interpret five psychological tests during the year.

chapters.name: Variations in Psychological Attributes
topics: Individual differences in human functioning; assessment of psychological attributes
Intelligence: psychometric theories, PASS model, triarchic theory, multiple intelligences
Individual differences in intelligence; culture and intelligence
Emotional intelligence
Special abilities: aptitude, nature and measurement; creativity

chapters.name: Self and Personality
topics: Concept of self; cognitive and behavioural aspects; culture and self
Concept of personality
Approaches: type, trait, psychodynamic and post-Freudian, behavioural, cultural, humanistic
Assessment: self-report measures, projective techniques, behavioural analysis

chapters.name: Meeting Life Challenges
topics: Nature, types and sources of stress
Effects on psychological functioning and health: general adaptation syndrome, immune system, lifestyle
Coping with stress; stress management techniques
Promoting positive health and well-being: life skills, positive health

chapters.name: Psychological Disorders
topics: Concepts of abnormality; historical background
Classification of disorders; factors underlying abnormal behaviour
Anxiety, obsessive-compulsive, trauma- and stressor-related, somatic symptom and dissociative disorders
Depressive and bipolar disorders; schizophrenia spectrum
Neurodevelopmental; disruptive, impulse-control and conduct; feeding and eating; substance related and addictive disorders

chapters.name: Therapeutic Approaches
topics: Nature and process of psychotherapy; therapeutic relationship
Behaviour, cognitive, humanistic-existential and alternative therapies
Factors contributing to healing; ethics in psychotherapy
Rehabilitation of the mentally ill

chapters.name: Attitude and Social Cognition
topics: Explaining social behaviour
Nature and components of attitudes
Attitude formation, change and the attitude-behaviour relationship
Prejudice and discrimination; strategies for handling prejudice

chapters.name: Social Influence and Group Processes
topics: Nature and formation of groups; types of groups
Influence of group on individual behaviour: social loafing, group polarisation
